correctness.rationale: Conditioning on proposed A endpoint arrival times u,v, exterior one-sided shielding probabilities independently factor h_A(u)h_A(v). The intervening B proposal obstructs iff it arrives before min(u,v), so the exact central factor is 1-beta min(u,v). The Volterra shielding equations h_A'=-beta h_B,h_B'=-alpha h_A solve in cosh/sinh. For f(s)=h_A(s)²+beta s, f''(s)=2 beta² h_B²+2 alpha beta h_A²>0; endpoint bound f(1)<1 implies h_A(s)²<1-beta s. This makes the double-integral covariance density strictly positive. Decreasing-time nearest-neighbor ancestor chains have factorial tails, justifying infinite-volume limit. Independent numerical quadrature checked 9 parameter-time choices and the balanced closed form; finite tests do not prove infinite strict sign.
